scripts.test: npm run test:bootstrap && npm run test:engine && npm run test:backend
scripts.verify: npm run check:toolchain && npm run check:workspace && npm run check:sources && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.test:backend: npm run build && node --test services/game-api/test/*.test.mjs infra/firebase/test/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:emulator: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --config infra/firebase/firebase.json --project demo-mothership --only auth,firestore,functions "node --test --test-concurrency=1 services/game-api/test-emulator/*.test.mjs infra/firebase/test-emulator/*.test.mjs"
